topic: Handling sewer inspection calls during a busy route
hook_options: You're knee-deep in a sewer scope. Phone rings.
The plumber who picks up gets the job.
We hear the same thing from plumbers all the day long: I miss calls in the trench.
How many jobs did voicemail steal from you today?
Plumbing calls went straight to voicemail while you were scoping that line.
headline: You're knee-deep in a sewer scope. Phone rings.
caption:
Most callers don't leave a message. They just call the next guy on the list.
Pipeline Reception answers the calls your team can't get to and books the job right into your schedule.
